questions.stem: A company ships the same desktop model to offices in several countries with different outlet voltages. Which power supply lets every PC plug into local power without anyone setting a switch?
A desktop PC with a manual input voltage switch on its power supply is moving from the UK to the United States. What should the technician do before connecting it to power?

choices.text: Replace it with a higher wattage PSU
Set the switch to low-line (120 VAC)
Set the switch to high-line (230 VAC)
Replace it with a modular PSU

questions.stem: After a technician adds a second graphics card to a PC with a 450 W power supply, the PC starts shutting down at random. Which of the following is the BEST fix?

choices.text: Install a PSU with a higher wattage rating
Install a modular PSU in its place
Install a 450 W PSU rated 80 PLUS Gold
Install a PSU with a higher output voltage

questions.stem: A technician comparing power supplies for a gaming PC checks the +12 V rail rating first. Which of the following BEST explains why?

choices.text: It shares a combined limit with the +5 V rail
Modern parts draw the most power from it
It is the rail that powers standby mode
It sets the PSU's 80 PLUS efficiency level

questions.stem: A power supply running at 80% efficiency is delivering 200 W to a PC's parts. How much power is it drawing from the wall outlet?
A technician measures the voltages on the main power cable from a PC's power supply to the motherboard. Which set of voltages should the technician expect?

reference.title: Power Supply Connectors
reference.find: supply DC voltage to the motherboard

questions.stem: A technician is putting a new power supply into an older PC whose motherboard has a 20-pin main power port. Which power supply cable is designed to fit this port?
A technician is learning the wire colors on a power supply's main motherboard cable. Which of the following color matches are correct?
A technician is planning a new PC whose parts need only two drive power cables. The technician wants as much airflow inside the case as possible. Which type of power supply is the BEST choice?
A store's web server must stay online all day. If a power supply fails, a technician must swap it out without turning the server off. Which of the following makes this possible?
A technician notices thin metal plates on a PC's memory modules that help keep them cool. What are these plates?

reference.title: Heat Sinks and Thermal Paste
reference.find: Memory modules use passive heat sinks

questions.stem: A technician is replacing the fan and heat sink on the CPU of an older office PC. What should go between the CPU and the new heat sink so heat transfers well?

reference.title: Heat Sinks and Thermal Paste
reference.find: thermal paste/pad to eliminate air gaps

questions.stem: A gamer is adding an open-loop liquid cooling system to a PC. What is the job of the water blocks in this system?

choices.text: Move the coolant through the tubing
Pull heat from a device into the coolant
Hold extra coolant used to refill the loop
Release heat from the coolant at a vent

questions.stem: A technician wants to keep a desktop PC from overheating. Which of the following actions will improve airflow and cooling inside the case?

choices.text: Unplug the heat sink fan from the motherboard
Route cables out of the airflow path
Put blanking plates over unused adapter slots
Clean dust from the fans and air vents
Pull cool air in through the back vents

questions.stem: A student building a desktop PC wants to add an internal DVD drive. Where should the drive be installed?
A school is replacing the hard drives in its computer lab with SSDs. Which of the following are advantages of the SSDs?

choices.text: They are less likely to fail if bumped
They never wear out from writing data
Their platters spin at a higher RPM
They cannot be damaged by static electricity

questions.stem: A new desktop has a small SSD and a large HDD. Which of the following should the technician place on the SSD?

reference.title: Solid-State Drives
reference.find: SSD hosting the OS and applications

questions.stem: A technician orders an SSD labeled 2280 that is powered by its motherboard slot. Which form factor is this SSD?
A technician wants an SSD that connects straight to the PCIe bus for the best speed. Which interface should the SSD use?
A technician is comparing two drives rated at 7,200 RPM and 10,000 RPM. What type of drives are these?
A small business PC has two drives, and each one holds an identical copy of every file. Which RAID level is the PC using?
A technician sets up two drives so that every file is written to both drives at the same time. Which RAID level is this?
A photographer puts four matching drives in a file server. Which RAID level survives one drive failure and leaves the MOST room for photos?

reference.title: RAID 5 and RAID 10
reference.find: one-quarter of each disk is reserved

questions.stem: A RAID 10 array built from four 2 TB drives shows only 4 TB of space. What should the technician do?

choices.text: Leave it as is, because 4 TB is expected
Replace the drive that failed during setup
Update the controller so it shows 8 TB
Add a fifth drive to store parity data

questions.stem: A school's grade server must keep running even if two of its drives fail at the same time. Which RAID level should the technician use?
A technician needs an SD card that can transfer large video files as fast as possible. Which kind of SD card is the BEST choice?
A user's smartphone is out of space for photos, but it has a tiny storage slot on its side. What should the user buy?
A user buys a pack of discs labeled BD-RE. What can the user do with these discs?

choices.text: Erase and rewrite them many times
Write to them only one time
Read them but never write to them
Add data in sessions but never erase it

questions.stem: An office PC runs its memory in single-channel mode. What is the typical width of the data bus that links the CPU to the RAM?
A technician removes an old memory module labeled PC2100. What is the module's peak transfer rate?

reference.title: RAM Types
reference.find: labeled by their maximum theoretical bandwidth

questions.stem: An older PC's memory runs at 1333 MT/s. What is the largest module size that this DDR generation supports?
Two DDR5 modules match in speed and size, but one is CAS 36 and one is CAS 40. Which should a gamer buy for the BEST performance?

choices.text: The CAS 40 module, since it has more bandwidth
The CAS 40 module, since higher latency is faster
Either one, since both have the same speed rating
The CAS 36 module, since lower latency is faster

questions.stem: A customer asks what DDR4 improved over DDR3. Which improvements should the technician mention?

choices.text: It checks for errors inside each module
It always uses a 72-bit data bus
It starts at 4800 MT/s data rates

reference.title: RAM Types
reference.find: increased power efficiency and higher density

questions.stem: Each new DDR generation moves more data per second than the one before it. Which of the following BEST explains how?

choices.text: By making the memory chips themselves run faster
By fitting more memory chips on each module
By multiplying how fast the memory bus runs
By adding 8 check bits to every transfer

questions.stem: A salesperson's laptop slows down when many apps are open. Which type of memory module should a technician add?
New DDR5 modules will not go into a PC's memory slots because the notches do not line up. What is the MOST likely cause?

choices.text: The slots are built for a different DDR generation
The modules run at a faster data rate than before
The modules have a higher CAS latency than before
The modules hold more gigabytes than the old ones

questions.stem: A customer asks a technician to order dual-channel memory modules for a new PC. What should the technician do?

choices.text: Order dual-channel modules, since standard ones will not work
Order registered modules, since dual-channel mode depends on them
Order ECC modules, since dual-channel mode depends on them
Order standard modules, since no dual-channel type exists

questions.stem: A technician correctly installs memory on a dual-channel motherboard, but the memory still runs in single-channel mode. What should the technician check next?

choices.text: Whether the modules are DIMMs or SODIMMs
Whether dual-channel mode is enabled in firmware
Whether the modules have heat sinks attached
Whether the modules are ECC or non-ECC

questions.stem: A technician is adding memory to a dual-channel motherboard. Which steps will help the memory run in dual-channel mode?

choices.text: Use modules that match in speed, size, and timings
Place one module in the same slot number on each channel
Pair one large module with one small module
Install an odd number of modules, such as three
Place both modules in the two slots of one channel

reference.title: Multi-channel System Memory
reference.find: identical modules in the corresponding slots

questions.stem: A clinic needs a server that can spot and fix memory errors while it keeps running. Which type of RAM is the BEST choice?

reference.title: ECC RAM
reference.find: detect and correct single-bit memory errors

questions.stem: After a technician adds a larger ECC module beside a desktop's smaller non-ECC module, the PC will not boot. What is the MOST likely cause?

choices.text: The modules mix ECC and non-ECC types
The new module needs a heat sink
The new module runs at a faster speed

questions.stem: A server's memory can fix single-bit errors on its own. What will MOST likely happen if one transfer has errors in several bits?

choices.text: It switches the memory into single-channel mode
It detects the error, shows a message, and halts
It fixes all of the bad bits and keeps running
It misses the error and the data stays corrupted

reference.title: ECC RAM
reference.find: error message and halting the system

questions.stem: A technician must buy ECC memory for a system that will hold a very large amount of RAM. Which choice is BEST?

choices.text: UDIMMs, since ECC needs no board or CPU support
SODIMMs, since they hold the most per module
UDIMMs, since most ECC memory is unbuffered
RDIMMs, since a register eases controller load

reference.title: ECC RAM
reference.find: Most ECC RAM is supplied as

questions.stem: A school is replacing old 32-bit PCs with x64 PCs that will run virtual machines. Which x64 features help the VMs run well and make the PCs more secure?

choices.text: VT-x or AMD-V support plus DEP
Dual-channel RAM plus a ZIF socket

reference.title: x64 CPU Architecture
reference.find: x64 architecture impacts virtualization and security

questions.stem: After installing 64-bit Windows 11, a technician finds that the scanner's disc has only a 32-bit driver. What should the technician do?

choices.text: Install the 32-bit driver from the disc
Replace the CPU with a 32-bit model
Download a 64-bit driver for the scanner

questions.stem: Windows shows eight processors for a four-core CPU because each core handles two tasks at once. Which CPU feature explains this?

reference.title: x86 CPU Architecture
reference.find: single core to handle multiple threads

questions.stem: A desktop has only one CPU socket, but its CPU chip holds six complete processors. What is this design called?

reference.title: CPU Features
reference.find: multicore CPU places multiple processing units

questions.stem: A technician is choosing a motherboard for a customer's new Intel Core i7 CPU. Which socket should the board have?

reference.title: CPU Socket Types
reference.find: Intel predominantly uses Land Grid Array

questions.stem: A technician has seated a new CPU, added thermal paste, and mounted the cooler. What should the technician do NEXT?

choices.text: Plug the cooler's fan into the CPU fan header
Spread more thermal paste around the CPU's edges
Line up the CPU's triangle with the socket mark
Twist the cooler gently to seat the CPU firmly

reference.title: CPU Types and Motherboard Compatibility
reference.find: connected to the CPU fan header

questions.stem: A technician opens a broken tablet that uses an ARM processor. Which of the following BEST describes the processor inside?

choices.text: An LGA processor held in a socket by a latch
A system-on-chip with video and network built in
A PGA processor that lifts out of its socket
A CPU chip with separate video and network chips

questions.stem: A school district is buying Chromebooks that use ARM processors. Which of the following are advantages of ARM in these laptops?

choices.text: Is easy to remove and upgrade
Supports large amounts of ECC RAM
Has a large, complex instruction set

reference.title: ARM CPU Architecture
reference.find: low power consumption and efficient heat
